processes.name: Processes
processes.description: Track runnable and zombie processes, with lists ranked by CPU and memory use.
processes.requirements: Requires Linux procps ps, awk and head. ps reports CPU use averaged over each process lifetime, not an instantaneous CPU sample.

network.name: Network counters
network.description: Inspect cumulative receive/transmit counters, dropped packets and socket summaries.
network.requirements: Requires Linux /proc/net/dev, /proc/net/sockstat, awk and cat. Totals exclude loopback but include virtual interfaces; they are cumulative counters, not throughput.

services.name: systemd services
services.description: Follow loaded service states and inspect failed units without changing services.
services.requirements: Requires a running systemd manager, systemctl access and awk. Counts cover loaded service units, not all installed unit files.

gpu.name: NVIDIA GPU
gpu.description: Track GPU count, combined framebuffer memory and the NVIDIA device/process summary.
gpu.requirements: Requires a Linux host with NVIDIA drivers, nvidia-smi and awk. Unsupported memory values (N/A) are reported as errors instead of zero.

runbook.name: Operations notes
runbook.description: Keep an editable handover checklist and environment details beside your metrics. Works without SSH connections.

mixed.name: Mixed operations
mixed.description: A combined dashboard with Linux metrics, Docker status and handover notes. Assign each collection group to its own SSH hosts.

handover.name: Handover checklist
handover.content:
## Handover

- [ ] Check host capacity and recent trends
- [ ] Review failed services or containers
- [ ] Record recent changes and follow-up work

### Contacts and references

Add the owner, incident links and recovery steps here.

templates.sharedHelp: Matching commands and connection sets share a source. Repeated cards from overlapping templates appear once.

dashboard.resizeHelp: Drag to resize, or use arrow keys to change width and height.
dashboard.moveHelp: Drag to move, or use arrow keys. Nearby cards move aside.
dashboard.hiddenCards: Hidden cards — select one to show it again

notes.help: Add instructions, links or notes. No connection or command is needed; content stays available while collection is paused.
notes.previewEmpty: Your content will appear here as you type.
notes.tooLong: Content must be no larger than 64 KiB.
notes.required: Enter a title and some content.

dashboard.previewEvicted: Raw output was released to save memory. Run a trial to preview it again; the last displayed values are kept.
dashboard.collectionPolicy: Foreground and background use the configured interval. Slow commands never overlap or catch up missed runs. Failures back off up to 60s or your longer interval.
